messages:
Priya R: FYI — Qonto asked for a per-route cost breakdown + 99th-percentile trace capture for a small set of hot routes before GA. They said: 'we need to detect cost regressions early'.

Alex M: got it. are they asking for full traces on 99th only or sampling + full capture on triggers?

Priya R: they want deterministic 99th traces for the top 10 routes by traffic, not full global trace capture (cost concern).

Samir K: ok that aligns with the canary idea. we can enable full KV/trace dumps for those routes during canary windows. need to estimate token/trace cost though.

Elaine: quick numbers — if we capture traces with full payload for 0.1% of requests at peak, token delta ~ +12% for those routes. for deterministic 99th we probably need higher coverage during short window.

Alex M: +1 on short window. propose: 24h deterministic window for the 10 routes, otherwise 0.1% sampling. that keeps cost bounded.

Priya R: that sounds reasonable. customers also asking for a per-route line-item in console billing UI (breakdown by model/route).

Kate (ops): UI asks are heavy — we can surface per-route cost by combining token counts + model unit price. backend metrics needed: route_id, tokens_in, tokens_out, model_version.

Samir K: backend side: we already emit per-request metadata in traces, but aggregators drop route tags for efficiency. we can flip a flag to keep route tags for dedicated routes.

Alex M: can we do a lightweight proto first? a new metric: route.cost_tokens, emitted to telemetry with labels {route, model}. then the console can show approximate $/route. no PII.

Priya R: launch criteria proposal: 1) Per-route cost metric live for top 100 routes, 2) Deterministic 99th trace capture available behind a canary flag for top 10 routes, 3) Docs + runbook for customers, 4) Cost alerting for >20% delta month-over-month.

Elaine: short checklist note: instrument qps and tail latency for those routes, map to cost buckets. if 99th traces spike token usage >30% we auto-disable and notify.

Kate (ops): dependency list: metric schema change (telemetry), small runtime flag to preserve route tags, console UI tile + drilldown, billing calc job change. estimate: 2 engs backend (2 sprints), 1 frontend (1 sprint), docs (0.5 sprint).

Alex M: risks: sampling mismatch (deterministic window may not capture true tail), data volume blowup if route selection is wrong, enterprise customers will want exportable CSVs.

Samir K: mitigations: default to conservative route set (top 10 by token-volume), provide easy opt-in for customers to add routes, and a quota to cap trace token spend per-org.

Priya R: customer comms — offer Qonto a short pilot with SLA: 24h deterministic window, cost cap of $X, weekly sync. If that proves out, we fold into GA requirements.

Alex M: quick UX ask: for the console tile show "estimated $/24h" with toggle for "show token breakdown" and link to raw traces.

Kate (ops): noted. for billing calc we need model price table versioning. that should be in the docs and traced in telemetry.

Elaine: one more: add an alert for "unexpected trace token surge" routed to oncall + account manager. make it actionable: shows top-n routes and recent token delta.

Priya R: action items: Priya -> draft pilot SOW for Qonto by Wed, Samir -> prototype runtime flag + metric emit by EOW, Alex -> mock console tile by Tue, Kate -> scope billing calc change and estimate. I'll schedule a 30m sync Friday.

deploy-bot: reminder — create a sprint ticket for "obs: per-route cost metric" when ready (link placeholder)
